audit.whatIsWrong: The entry teaches that Ornn needs a wall for his knockup — "Land E charge into a wall for the knockup", "Stand near walls for his Q".
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture leaves a magma pillar at the end of the fissure, and that pillar is terrain. Searing Charge knocks up when Ornn collides with terrain — including his own pillar. So Ornn manufactures his own knockup anywhere on the map, and a Zac who thinks he is safe by standing in open lane away from the sidewalls is standing in exactly the wrong place. This is the single most decisive interaction in the matchup and both layers get it backwards.
audit.corrected: Q leaves a pillar; E into that pillar is the knockup. No wall required — the danger zone is his Q, not the terrain.

audit.whatIsWrong: Brittle is attributed to Searing Charge — "his Searing Charge E brittle-and-knockup", "avoid Searing Charge E to deny brittle procs".
audit.why: Brittle comes from Bellows Breath: "Enemies hit by the final gout of flame become Brittle." Searing Charge is damage plus a terrain-conditional knockup and applies no Brittle at all. A player told to dodge E to avoid Brittle will dodge the wrong ability and eat the debuff anyway.
audit.corrected: Bellows Breath applies Brittle, on its final gout. Searing Charge is the knockup.

audit.whatIsWrong: Call of the Forge God is described as a knockup engage with no range, no cooldown, and no distinction between the cast and the recast.
audit.why: It is 2500 range on a 140/120/100s cooldown. The initial pass damages, slows and applies Brittle; only the RECAST, where Ornn charges into the elemental to redirect it, knocks up. That distinction is what decides whether a Zac who has already committed should keep going or bail, and 140s at rank 1 is the largest punish window in the lane.
audit.corrected: 2500 range, 140s at rank 1; the first pass slows and brittles, the recast is the knockup.

audit.whatIsWrong: Living Forge was reduced to "his passive lets him build ahead".
audit.why: Living Forge gives bonus Armor and Magic Resist from all sources, lets Ornn purchase non-consumable items anywhere without recalling, and lets him hand masterwork upgrades to teammates. The no-recall shopping is what actually beats Zac in lane: Ornn never gives up the wave to spend gold, so the recall-tempo game Zac normally plays is off the table.
audit.corrected: He buys without recalling, so you never get a free wave off his back-timer.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere in a matchup Zac loses.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s, Searing Charge 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s, Call of the Forge God 140/120/100s. In a losing lane the only actionable advice is which gap to step into, and none of the three gaps was quantified.

Content win[] gives Ornn all seven stages against a 41.87% Zac record over 203 games. A clean sweep is defensible at that win rate and the entry does not invent a fake Zac window to break it up, which is the right call. Left as is.

edits.before: Ornn out-trades you flat: his Searing Charge E brittle-and-knockup plus Bellows Breath shield and self-sustain mean every scrum favors him, and his passive lets him build ahead while zoning you off farm.
edits.after: Ornn out-trades you flat: Volcanic Rupture leaves a magma pillar and Searing Charge knocks up off any terrain it hits, so he makes his own knockup in open lane, and Living Forge lets him build ahead of you.

edits.after: Call of the Forge God summons from 2500 away and beats your E Elastic Slingshot at range — he initiates before you close, and only the recast knocks up. 140s at rank 1.

edits.after: Q a pillar then E into it — his knockup needs no wall at all

edits.before: Level 3 his Searing Charge brittle-knockup combo beats your scrum.
edits.after: Level 3 his Q-pillar into E knockup lands with no wall nearby.

edits.after: Level 6 his 2500-range R engage out-reaches your slingshot.

edits.before: Ornn is a losing lane — the 42% winrate says so. His Searing Charge E gives a knockup and brittle setup, Bellows Breath shields and sustains through your poke, and he builds items in-lane to snowball tankiness. Farm cautiously and don't contest his shove.
edits.after: Ornn is a losing lane — the 42% winrate says so. Searing Charge knocks up off terrain, Bellows Breath is what applies Brittle, and Living Forge buys him items without recalling, so you never get a free wave. Farm cautiously and concede his shove.

edits.before: It doesn't improve at 6. Call of the Forge God R initiates from further than your E Elastic Slingshot reaches, and he can brittle you for a hard follow-up. His first item spike makes him tankier and higher-damage than you, so your W trades keep losing.
edits.after: It doesn't improve at 6. Call of the Forge God summons from 2500 and initiates from further than your slingshot reaches, and Bellows Breath brittles you for the follow-up. It is 140s at rank 1, and that gap is your only real window.

edits.before: Ornn stays on top late: his recast R knocks you out of Let's Bounce!, and his brittle amps his team's whole CC chain, outweighing your single engage. Play for objectives and cross-map, look for picks when his R is down, and lean on your team rather than the 1v1.
edits.after: Ornn stays on top late: only the recast of his R knocks up, and Brittle off Bellows Breath amps his team's whole CC chain, outweighing your single engage. Play objectives and cross-map, look for picks in the 140s his R is down, and lean on your team.

edits.before: Late Ornn stays ahead — his R can be recast to knock you up mid-Let's Bounce!, and his brittle amplifies his whole team's CC, out-scaling your single engage in fights.
edits.after: Late Ornn stays ahead — his R recast knocks you up mid-Let's Bounce!, and Brittle from Bellows Breath amplifies his team's whole CC, out-scaling your single engage.

edits.before: - Ornn Volcanic Rupture: matchup-defining — Wall-knockup setup. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ornn Volcanic Rupture (Q, 9s): matchup-defining — the pillar it leaves is what lets Searing Charge knock up, so dodge both. - Call of the Forge God: 140s. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Wall-knockup setup. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: The pillar sets up his E knockup. Only engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: Elastic Slingshot from fog + R bounces win every river fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ornn's ultimate changes the math too.

UNVERIFIED, left alone: the entry describes Bellows Breath as a shield. Riot's Data Dragon text for W mentions only the advance, the fire and the Brittle application, and the derived flags carry no shield — but an absent flag means unknown, not absent, so I removed the shield claim from spikes[0] and early by replacing those sentences with facts I could source, rather than asserting Ornn has no shield. Worth a League Wiki check. Also NOT usable: the derived grounding flag on Volcanic Rupture is a false positive from the phrase 'slams the ground' — Ornn has no grounding, and I did not write any. SYSTEMIC AND SERIOUS HERE: content win[] gives Ornn all seven stages, but full phases[].side reads Skill, Zac, Zac, Skill, Skill, Zac, Zac — the full layer hands Zac three stages and the Skill label four times in a lane Zac loses 58% of.
